story.title: Welcome to Taiwan! - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
明華：請問你是陳月美小姐嗎？
月美：是的。謝謝你來接我們。
明華：不客氣。我是李明華。
月美：這是王先生。
開文：你好。我姓王，叫開文。
明華：你們好。歡迎你們來臺灣。
明華：請喝茶。
開文：謝謝。很好喝。請問這是什麼茶？
明華：這是烏龍茶。臺灣人喜歡喝茶。開文，你們日本人呢？
月美：他不是日本人。
明華：對不起，你是哪國人？
開文：我是美國人。
明華：開文，你要不要喝咖啡？
開文：謝謝！我不喝咖啡，我喜歡喝茶。
story.english:
明華: Excuse me, are you Miss Chen Yuemei?
月美: Yes. Thank you for coming to pick us up.
明華: You're welcome. My name is Minghua Li.
月美: This is Mr. Wang.
開文: Hi, my surname is Wang. My first name is Kaiwen.
明華: How are you? Welcome to Taiwan.
明華: Please have some tea.
開文: Thank you. This tastes good. May I ask what kind of tea this is?
明華: This is Oolong tea. Taiwanese like to drink tea. Kaiwen, how about you Japanese people?
月美: He is not Japanese.
明華: I am sorry. Which country are you from?
開文: I am American.
明華: Kaiwen, would you like to drink coffee?
開文: Thank you. I don't drink coffee. I like to drink tea.

story.title: My Family - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
怡君：這是我家。請進！
安同：很漂亮的房子！
怡君：請坐！要不要喝茶？
安同：好，謝謝你。你家有很多照片。
怡君：我家人都很喜歡照相。
安同：這張照片很好看。這是誰？你姐姐嗎？
怡君：不是，是我妹妹。這是我爸爸、媽媽。
安同：你家人都很好看。
明華：田中，歡迎！歡迎！請進。
田中：謝謝。
明華：田中，這是我媽媽。
田中：伯母，您好。
明華的媽媽：你好，你好。來！來！來！請坐。你叫什麼名字？
田中：我叫誠一。你們家有很多書。
明華：都是我哥哥的書。他是老師，他很喜歡看書。
明華的媽媽：誠一，你家有幾個人？你有沒有兄弟姐妹？
田中：我家有五個人，我有兩個妹妹。

怡君: The people in my family like to take pictures.
安同: This is a nice picture. Who is this? Your older sister?
怡君: No, that is my younger sister. These are my dad and mom.

田中: There are five people in my family. I have two younger sisters.

story.title: What Are You Doing Over the Weekend? - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
安同：田中，你喜歡聽音樂嗎？
田中：我不喜歡聽音樂。我喜歡運動。
安同：你喜歡打網球嗎？
田中：我不喜歡打網球。
安同：你喜歡做什麼？
田中：打棒球和游泳，你呢？
安同：我常打籃球，也常踢足球。
田中：我覺得踢足球很好玩。
安同：明天是週末，我們早上去踢足球，怎麼樣？
田中：好啊！
如玉：今天晚上我們去看電影，好不好？
月美：好啊！
如玉：妳想看美國電影還是臺灣電影？
月美：美國電影、臺灣電影，我都想看。
如玉：我們看臺灣電影吧！
月美：好啊！看電影可以學中文。
如玉：晚上要不要一起吃晚飯？
月美：好，我們去吃越南菜。
story.english:

田中: Play baseball and swim. And you?
安同: I often play basketball and also often play soccer.
田中: I think soccer is fun.
安同: The weekend is tomorrow. How about we go play soccer tomorrow morning?
田中: Great!
如玉: Let's go see a movie tonight, OK?
月美: Sure.
如玉: Do you want to see an American movie or a Taiwanese movie?
月美: Either an American movie or a Taiwanese film is fine with me.
如玉: Let's go ahead and see a Taiwanese movie.
月美: That's fine. Watching movies, I can learn Chinese.
如玉: Would you like to have dinner together tonight?
月美: Okay. Let's go have Vietnamese food.

story.title: Excuse Me. How Much Does That Cost in Total? - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
老闆：請問你要買什麼？
明華：一杯熱咖啡。兩個包子。
老闆：你要大杯、中杯還是小杯？
明華：大杯。包子請幫我微波。
老闆：好的。請問外帶還是內用？
明華：外帶，一共多少錢？
老闆：咖啡八十，包子四十，一共一百二十塊。
月美：我想買一支新手機。
明華：妳的手機很好。為什麼要買新的？
月美：我這支手機太舊了，不好看。
明華：妳想買哪種手機？
月美：能照相也能上網。
明華：那種手機很好，我哥哥有一支。
月美：貴不貴？一支賣多少錢？
明華：那種手機不便宜。一支要一萬五千多。

story.title: Beef Noodles Are Really Delicious - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
月美：很多人都說臺灣有不少有名的小吃。
明華：是啊！牛肉麵、小籠包、臭豆腐⋯都很好吃。
月美：你最喜歡吃什麼？
明華：牛肉麵。牛肉好吃，湯也好喝。
月美：這麼好吃，我很想吃。
明華：我知道一家有名的牛肉麵店，我們一起去吃，怎麼樣？
月美：太好了！
明華：我們明天去。一定要點大碗的。
月美：昨天晚上那家餐廳的菜很好吃，可是有一點辣。
安同：我也怕辣，所以我喜歡自己做飯。
月美：你做飯做得怎麼樣？
安同：我做得不好。妳會做飯嗎？
月美：會。我的甜點也做得不錯。
安同：我最喜歡吃甜點。妳可以教我嗎？
月美：好的，這個週末，你到我家來。
安同：好啊！謝謝妳。
story.english:
月美: Many people say Taiwan has quite a few well-known light repasts.
明華: That's right. Beef noodles, xiaolongbao, stinky tofu... are all tasty.
月美: What do you like to eat most?
明華: Beef noodles. The beef tastes good and the soup is nice.
月美: That tasty. I would like to have some.
明華: I know a place that is well-known for its beef noodles. Let's go together and have some. What do you say?
月美: Wonderful!
明華: Let's go tomorrow. You really have to order a large bowl.
月美: The food at the restaurant last night was good, but it was a bit spicy.
安同: I can't take spicy (food), either. That is why I prefer to cook for myself.
月美: How well do you cook?
安同: I don't cook well. Can you cook?
月美: Yes. I make good desserts, too.
安同: I like eating desserts most. Could you teach me?
月美: Sure. Come over to my place this weekend.
安同: Great! Thank you.

story.title: Going to KTV at 9 O'clock in the Morning - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
安同：月美，妳要去哪裡？
月美：去KTV唱歌。我和朋友九點二十分在大安KTV見面。
安同：早上九點去KTV？為什麼？
月美：從早上七點到中午十二點，最便宜。要不要一起去？
安同：我想去，可是我得去銀行。下次吧！
月美：好啊，下次你一定要來，我想聽你唱歌。
安同：沒問題。對了，什麼時候有空一起吃飯？
月美：後天我有空，你呢？
安同：我也有空，後天晚上七點怎麼樣？
月美：好啊！再見。
安同：如玉，妳在吃飯啊？
如玉：是，吃午餐，等一下要上課。你呢？
安同：我剛下課。對了，下午四點半學校有籃球比賽。妳想去看嗎？
如玉：想啊。比賽幾點結束？
安同：六點半。妳晚上有事嗎？
如玉：我最近很忙，每天晚上都上書法課。
安同：學得怎麼樣？
如玉：剛開始學，字寫得不好，可是我覺得很有意思。
安同：我有空可以去看看嗎？
如玉：我得問問老師。
story.english:

月美: Because from 7:00 in the morning to 12 noon, it is the least expensive. Do you want to go along?
安同: I would love to, but I have to go to the bank. Maybe next time.
月美: Okay. Next time, you have to come. I would like to hear you sing.
安同: No problem. By the way, when do you have time to eat with me?
月美: I'm free the day after tomorrow. Yourself?
安同: I'm also free. How about the day after tomorrow at 7:00 in the evening?
月美: Great. See you.
安同: (I see) you're eating, Ruyu?
如玉: Yeah, I'm eating lunch. I have class in a bit. How about you?
安同: I just got out of class. By the way, there is a basketball game at school at 4:30 this afternoon. Would you like to go watch?
如玉: Yes, what time does the game end?
安同: 6:30. Do you have something to do this evening?
如玉: I have been busy lately. I go to calligraphy class every evening.
安同: How is that (the studying) going?
如玉: I just started studying. I'm not writing characters well, but I think it is interesting.
安同: Can I go check it out?
如玉: Let me ask the teacher.

story.chinese:

如玉：可是聽說高鐵車票非常貴。
明華：高鐵車票有一點貴，但是坐高鐵又快又舒服。
如玉：我不知道在哪裡買票。
明華：在高鐵站、網路上或是便利商店都可以。
如玉：這麼方便！那我坐高鐵去，謝謝你。
如玉：安同，明天我們沒課，你想去哪裡？

如玉：聽說那裡有很多中國古代的東西。
安同：是啊。妳要跟我們去看看嗎？

安同：我同學騎機車載我。妳可以坐公共汽車去。
如玉：我想坐捷運去。比較快。
安同：不行，到故宮沒有捷運。妳要不要坐計程車去？
如玉：太貴了！我坐公車。騎機車比坐公車快嗎？

story.title: Where Will You Go for the Holidays? - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
安同：田中，下個星期我們放五天的假，你要回國嗎？
田中：不，我打算在家看電視、影片學中文，你呢？
安同：我想跟朋友去玩。
田中：不錯啊。去什麼地方？
安同：臺東。聽說那裡的風景非常漂亮。
田中：我也聽說。放假的時候，你常去旅行嗎？
安同：不一定。有時候在家寫功課，有時候出去玩。
田中：你們什麼時候去臺東？
安同：這個星期六下午去。
田中：去玩多久？
安同：大概玩四、五天。
田中：我女朋友九月三十號要來臺灣看我。
明華：你想帶她去哪裡玩？
田中：還不知道。你有什麼建議？
明華：臺灣的夜市很有名。你們應該去逛逛。
田中：謝謝，還有什麼好玩的地方？
明華：臺灣的茶也很特別。臺北有很多茶館。
田中：到哪裡喝茶比較好？
明華：你們可以去貓空。那裡的風景很美。
田中：謝謝你。我決定帶她去貓空。你也一起去，好不好？
明華：要是那時候我有空，就跟你們一起去。
田中：太好了！謝謝！
story.english:
安同: Tianzhong, we are having a five-day break next week. Are you going back to your country?
田中: No. I plan on staying home and watching television and films to study Chinese. And you?
安同: I want to go out with my friends.
田中: That sounds good. Go where?
安同: Taitung. I've heard the scenery there is very pretty.
田中: I've heard that, too. Do you often travel on days off?
安同: Not necessarily. Sometimes, I stay home to do homework. Sometimes, I go out.
田中: When will you go to Taitung?
安同: (We're) going this Saturday afternoon.
田中: How long will you be there?
安同: Probably four or five days.
田中: My girlfriend is coming to Taiwan on September 30th to see me.
明華: Where do you plan to take her?
田中: Don't know yet. Do you have any suggestions?
明華: Taiwan's night markets are famous. You should go to the night market.
田中: Thank you. What other places are fun?
明華: Taiwanese tea is also very special. Taipei has many tea houses.
田中: Where's a good place to go have tea?
明華: You could go to Maokong. The scenery there is beautiful.
田中: Thank you. I've decided to take her to Maokong. You come with us, okay?
明華: If I am free at that time, then I will go with you.
田中: Great! Thank you!

story.chinese:

月美：芒果。給妳一塊，吃吃看。
如玉：好，謝謝。[taking a bite] 香香的、甜甜的，很好吃。
月美：昨天明華給我們的那種水果，紅色的，叫什麼？
如玉：妳說的是西瓜吧？
月美：對！對！對！臺灣有很多好吃的水果。
如玉：我以前不喜歡吃水果，現在很喜歡了。
月美：越南的水果也很好吃。
如玉：要是有機會，我想吃吃看。
月美：妳來越南，我一定請妳吃。

story.title: I Would Like to Rent a Place - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
如玉：林先生，你好，我是白如玉，來看房子。
房東：白小姐，妳好，請進。
房東：這裡是客廳，廚房在左邊，右邊有浴室。
如玉：房子很不錯。
房東：這裡很方便，附近有超市和捷運站，走路五分鐘就到了。
如玉：現在有人住嗎？
房東：有。還有兩間空房間，一間是套房，一間不是。
如玉：我想看套房。房間裡面可以上網嗎？
房東：可以。妳覺得這間房間怎麼樣？妳想租嗎？
如玉：我回去想想，再打電話給你。
如玉：喂，房東先生，你好，我是白如玉，你收到我的房租了嗎？
房東：我已經收到了，謝謝。妳習慣了嗎？
如玉：習慣了。可是，有一個問題，熱水器的水好像不熱。
房東：今天我會去看看。妳什麼時候有空？晚上可以嗎？
如玉：不好意思，今天晚上我有事。
房東：沒關係，明天下午呢？
如玉：好，我在家等你。
房東：那我明天下午兩點到。還有問題嗎？
如玉：我想買電視。請問可以幫我裝有線電視嗎？
房東：可以，不過妳得自己付錢。
如玉：好的，謝謝你。
story.english:
如玉: Hi, Mr. Lin. I am Bai Ruyu. I'm here to look at the house.
房東: Miss Bai, how are you? Please come in.
房東: This is the living room. The kitchen is to the left. The bathroom is to the right.
如玉: The place is nice.
房東: It is conveniently located. Nearby, there are a supermarket and an MRT station. Walk five minutes and you're there.
如玉: Does anyone live here now?
房東: Yes. There are still two vacant rooms. One is a suite (a room with a bath) and the other one is not.
如玉: I'd like to take a look at the suite. Can you access the internet from the room?
房東: Yes. What do you think of this room? Do you want to rent it?
如玉: Let me go back and think it over. I'll call you.
如玉: Hello, Mr. Landlord. This is Bai Ruyu. Have you received my rent?
房東: I have received it. Thank you. Are you accustomed (to living there)?
如玉: Yes. But there is a problem. The water from the water heater doesn't seem to be hot.
房東: I will go check it out today. When are you free? Would tonight be okay?
如玉: I am sorry. I've got something to do this evening.
房東: That is alright. How about tomorrow afternoon?
如玉: Okay. I will wait for you at home.
房東: I will be there at two. Are there any other problems?
如玉: I want to buy a television. Could I trouble you to put in cable for me?
房東: Yes, but you will have to pay for it yourself.
如玉: Fine. Thank you.

story.title: How Long Will You Be Studying Chinese in Taiwan? - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
田中：安同，你計畫在臺灣學多久的中文？
安同：五年。
田中：為什麼要這麼久的時間？
安同：我先在語言中心念一年，再念四年大學，所以需要五年。
田中：這得花不少錢！
安同：對，不過我有獎學金。要是成績不好，就沒獎學金了。你呢？
田中：我的學費是公司替我付的。
安同：你打算學多久呢？
田中：大概兩年，是公司決定的。
安同：希望我以後也可以到這麼好的公司上班。
田中：我又要上班，又要念書，真的很累。
安同：我們一起加油吧！
月美：田中，你是什麼時候來臺灣工作的？
田中：去年，我已經在臺灣工作一年了。
月美：為什麼你們公司要替你付學費？
田中：因為我們公司跟臺灣人做生意。老闆希望我們都會說中文。
月美：我覺得你們公司真好。
田中：對了，妳回國以後，打算做什麼？
月美：我回國以後，也想找個有機會說中文的工作。
田中：不錯，這樣的工作在你們國家好找嗎？
月美：不知道好不好找，我試試看。
田中：要是難找呢？
月美：那麼我再來臺灣學中文。
田中：太好了！那我們就可以再見面了。
story.english:
田中: Antong, how long do you plan to study Chinese in Taiwan?
安同: Five years.
田中: Why such a long time?
安同: I am going to study for a year at the language center, then study at university for four years, so I need five years.
田中: That's going to cost a lot of money.
安同: That's right, but I have a scholarship. If my grades are poor, I will lose it. And you?
田中: My tuition is paid by my company for me.
安同: And how long do you plan to study?
田中: Probably two years. My company will decide.
安同: I hope later I can work at such a good company.
田中: I have to both work and study. It is exhausting.
安同: Let's keep up the good work.
月美: When did you come to Taiwan to work, Tianzhong?
田中: Last year. I have been working in Taiwan for a year.
月美: Why does your company pay tuition for you?
田中: Because our company does business with Taiwanese. My boss wants us all to speak Chinese.
月美: I think your company is really good.
田中: By the way, what do you plan to do when you go back to your country?
月美: After I go back home, I would like to find a job (that gives me) opportunities to speak Chinese.
田中: Not a bad idea. Is that kind of job easy to find in your country?
月美: I don't know if they are easy to find, but I am going to try.
田中: What if they are hard to find?
月美: Then, I would come back to Taiwan to study Chinese.
田中: Great. That way we can meet again.

story.title: Happy Birthday - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
怡君：喂，安同嗎？
安同：是，我就是。怡君，好久不見，聽說妳去花蓮？
怡君：我沒去花蓮，我剛從臺東回來。
安同：找我有什麼事？
怡君：明天是你的生日，對不對？
安同：啊，我怎麼忘了！最近太忙了，謝謝妳還記得。
怡君：當然記得！語言交換的時候，你那麼熱心教我西班牙文。
安同：不必客氣，妳也一樣。
怡君：明天我想請你吃晚飯，給你過生日。
安同：妳太客氣了。我們在哪裡見面呢？
怡君：明天我一下課，就去你們學校找你。
安同：大概幾點？
怡君：五點左右。
安同：好。我會在學校門口等妳。
安同：怡君，謝謝妳請我到這麼有名的餐廳吃飯。
怡君：哪裡，哪裡！這是我給你的禮物。
安同：謝謝！真開心，今年有臺灣朋友給我過生日。
怡君：你想吃什麼？有沒有不吃的東西？
安同：我什麼都吃。
怡君：我已經訂了豬腳麵線和蛋。等一下你多吃一點。
安同：臺灣人過生日是不是都吃這些東西？
怡君：對啊！這是傳統，不過，現在大部分年輕人過生日不吃這些東西了。
安同：那麼，你們過生日吃什麼呢？
怡君：跟你們一樣，吃蛋糕。今天我也訂了一個生日蛋糕。
安同：妳對我真好。
怡君：安同，祝你生日快樂、萬事如意、心想事成。
安同：謝謝！謝謝！
story.english:
怡君: Hello? Is this Antong?
安同: Yes, this is he. Yijun, long time no see. I heard you went to Hualien.
怡君: I didn't go to Hualien. I just got back from Taitung.
安同: Did you call me for some reason?
怡君: Tomorrow is your birthday, isn't it?
安同: Huh!? How did I forget!? I've been so busy lately. Thanks for remembering.
怡君: Of course I remember. When we were exchanging languages, you were so enthusiastic about teaching me Spanish.
安同: You are too kind. You were, too.
怡君: I would like to treat you to dinner tomorrow to celebrate your birthday.
安同: That is very kind of you. Where should we meet?
怡君: As soon as I'm out of class tomorrow, I will go to your school.
安同: About what time?
怡君: About five.
安同: Good. I will wait for you at the front gate of the school.
安同: Yijun, thank you for asking me to eat at this well-known restaurant.
怡君: Not at all. Not at all. This is my gift to you.
安同: Thank you. I am really happy that a Taiwanese friend is celebrating my birthday with me this year.
怡君: What would you like to eat? Is there anything you don't eat?
安同: I eat anything.
怡君: I made a special order of pork knuckles with extra fine noodles and eggs before coming to the restaurant. (When it gets here,) dig in.
安同: Is that what Taiwanese eat on their birthdays?
怡君: Yes. This is a tradition, but most young people don't eat these things on their birthdays anymore.
安同: Then, what do you eat on your birthdays?
怡君: We eat cakes just like you. I also ordered a birthday cake.
安同: You are really nice to me.
怡君: Happy Birthday, Antong. I wish you the best in everything and may all your wishes come true.
安同: Thank you! Thank you!

story.title: It's So Cold! - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
如玉：外面風那麼大，我覺得今天比昨天冷。臺灣會不會下雪？
明華：很高的山會下雪。玉山常下雪。美國呢？開始下雪了吧？
如玉：還沒有。每年差不多十二月開始。下雪的時候，我常去山上滑雪。
明華：我怕冷。我比較喜歡春天。
如玉：春天不錯，天氣很舒服。
明華：我去年五月在紐約玩了兩個星期。那個時候，天氣很好，風景也很漂亮，我玩得非常開心。
如玉：我在臺灣住了半年多了。有一點想家。
明華：新年快到了。想回去看父母嗎？
如玉：我打算十二月底回去。想跟我去美國玩嗎？
明華：冬天太冷了。不過，我想明年秋天去看紅葉。對了，妳什麼時候回來？
如玉：因為我們只放十天的假，所以一月五號回來。
明華：如玉，雨下得這麼大，妳怎麼沒帶傘呢？
如玉：我昨天帶了，可是今天忘了帶。
明華：颱風快要來了。
如玉：我已經聽說了。
明華：這裡每年夏天都有颱風。颱風來的時候，風和雨都很大，做什麼都很不方便。
如玉：是啊！哪裡都濕濕的。真討厭。
明華：電視新聞說，這次的颱風會比上次的更大，請大家多小心。
如玉：希望這次的沒有上次的那麼可怕。
明華：如玉，妳看！雨停了。
如玉：太好了！謝謝你的傘，再見。
明華：不客氣。小心慢走。
story.english:
如玉: It is windy outside. I think it's colder today than yesterday. Does it snow in Taiwan?
明華: It snows on high mountains. It snows on Yushan frequently. And the US? It has probably started snowing (there).
如玉: Not yet. Every year around December, it starts. When it snows, I often go skiing in the mountains.
明華: I don't like the cold. I like spring better.
如玉: Spring isn't bad. The weather is nice.
明華: Last May, I was in New York having a good time for two weeks. The weather was very nice then and the scenery was beautiful. I had a great time.
如玉: I have lived in Taiwan for over half a year now. I'm a little homesick.
明華: It is almost New Year's. Are you thinking about going back to see your parents?
如玉: I plan to go back at the end of December. Would you like to go with me to the US?
明華: The winter is too cold, but I would like to go see the autumn leaves next year. By the way, when are you coming back?
如玉: We only have 10 days off, so I will be back January 5th.
明華: Ruyu, as heavy as it's raining, why didn't you bring an umbrella?
如玉: I brought it yesterday, but I forgot to bring it today.
明華: A typhoon is coming.
如玉: Yes, I've heard.
明華: We have typhoons every summer. When typhoons hit, we get heavy wind and rain. It gets very inconvenient to do anything.
如玉: Yeah. It gets wet everywhere. I hate it.
明華: The TV news says this typhoon is bigger than the last one and advised everyone to be extra cautious.
如玉: I hope the one this time is not as scary as the last one.
明華: Ruyu, Look. The rain has stopped.
如玉: Great! Thank you for the umbrella. See you.
明華: You're welcome. Take care.

story.title: I Don't Feel Well - Dialogue Reading
story.chinese:
醫生：白小姐，妳哪裡不舒服？
如玉：我一直流鼻水，頭很痛，胃口很差。什麼東西都不想吃。
醫生：大概多久了？
如玉：已經四、五天了。
醫生：我看看妳的喉嚨。喉嚨有一點發炎。
如玉：請問我生的是什麼病？
醫生：妳有一點發燒，是感冒，不過沒有什麼關係。
如玉：請問我得吃藥嗎？
醫生：要，妳到藥局去拿藥。
如玉：好的。請問我的病什麼時候會好？
醫生：回去把藥吃了，多喝水，多休息，早一點睡覺，很快就會好。
如玉：好的，謝謝您。
如玉：你怎麼了？臉色這麼難看。
安同：昨天晚上肚子很不舒服，吃了東西就吐，還吐了好幾次。
如玉：你這麼不舒服，我陪你去看病，好不好？
安同：不用了。我在臺灣沒有健康保險。
如玉：那麼，我陪你去學校的健康中心。那裡的醫生很好，對學生也很客氣。
安同：謝謝妳。我想去藥局買藥就好了。
如玉：你真的不去看病嗎？
安同：我想回家休息。請妳跟老師說，我生病了，不能上課。
如玉：好。你自己要多小心。油的、冰的東西最好都別吃。
安同：謝謝妳的關心。
如玉：我來看你了。現在覺得怎麼樣？好一點了嗎？
安同：謝謝妳，好多了。我吃了一包藥以後，睡得比昨天好。
如玉：不錯。你睡了幾個小時的覺以後，現在臉色比早上好得多了。
story.english:
醫生: Miss Bai, how are you doing? (Where are you feeling poorly?)
如玉: My nose continues to run, my head aches, and my appetite is poor. I don't want to eat anything.
醫生: How long has this been going on?
如玉: Four or five days already.
醫生: Let me take a look at your throat. Your throat is a bit inflamed.
如玉: Excuse me, what sickness do I have?
醫生: You have a slight fever. It is a cold, but it's nothing serious.
如玉: Excuse me, do I have to take any medicine?
醫生: Yes. Go to the pharmacy to pick up your medicine.
如玉: Thank you. Excuse me, when will I be well again?
醫生: Go home, take your medicine, drink plenty of water, get plenty of rest, and go to bed early and you'll be better very soon.
如玉: Fine, thank you.
如玉: What's the matter? You don't look too good.
安同: My stomach didn't feel good last night. I ate something and then threw up. I vomited several times.
如玉: You're feeling that badly. I'll go with you to see a doctor. Okay?
安同: No need. I don't have health insurance in Taiwan.
如玉: Then I'll go with you to the school's health center. The doctors there are good, and they are polite to students.
安同: Thank you. I think I'll just buy some medicine at a drug store. That should do it.
如玉: You're really not going to see a doctor?
安同: I just want to go home and rest. Please tell the teacher I am sick and I can't go to class.
如玉: Take care of yourself. You'd best not eat anything oily or cold.
安同: Thank you for your concern.
如玉: I came to see you. How are you feeling now? Any better?
安同: Thanks. Much better. After I took a pack of medicine, I slept better than yesterday.
如玉: Not bad. After sleeping for a few hours, your color is much better now than this morning.
